source_material_statement: HIGH GLOSS BLACK PIANO AND WHITE LACQUER WITH POLISHED BRASS CASTED BRONZE ORNAMENTS & CARVINGS DECORATED WITH ANTIQUE GOLD LEAF.
source_variant_note: Blue50292.0/50293.0 and red50490.0/50491.0/50492.0 are distinct upholstery/frame-detail families, not mere material colour variants. White-frame armchair50294.2 and white-frame TV50298.2 use printed WE.W finish references. Red two-seat50491.0 has printed dimensions but no separate image; the unaltered three-seat family image is shared and explicitly disclosed.
scope_note: Only WELLINGTON living-room pages25-31 (printed48-61) are in scope; page32 begins NANTES. Mirrors and consoles are individually dimensioned products despite sharing lifestyle compositions. Styling items and televisions are not additional catalogue product SKUs.
provenance_note: Images are exact original embedded JPEGs, documented native-density rectangular crops, or faithful native-density composites of original JPEGs with their original PDF soft masks over the original white page background. Raw source and mask bytes and hashes are retained. No AI replacement, super-resolution, new subject segmentation, synthesized missing product photo or subject alteration was performed.
reconstruction_caveat: Only printed dimensions and visibly documented surfaces are evidenced. Hidden joinery, exact material substrate, fabric weave, finish calibration and opening mechanisms are unverified interpretations. Source images alone do not establish whether imagery is photographed or rendered. Shared-family and lifestyle-crop limitations are disclosed per product.
rights_note: User-supplied MARINER catalogue; original product designs and imagery remain the rights of their owners. This evidence extraction conveys no commercial reuse licence or manufacturer endorsement.
